title: The AI Stock Investors Just Got Another MASSIVE Bull Signal!!
creator: Jose Najarro Stocks
summary: Jose Najarro covers Marvell Technology's investor day and Lisa Su's comments from Taipei, arguing both are fresh confirmation of the AI semiconductor demand cycle. Marvell raised its fiscal 2028 revenue outlook to about $20 billion (from $18 billion two months earlier, and $16.5 billion before that), with both raises driven by networking -- scale-up/scale-out optics and switching. Custom silicon's FY2029 target is now over $12 billion versus $10 billion-plus reaffirmed in August, and the FY2031 model calls for $70-90 billion in revenue implying over $30 of non-GAAP EPS at the midpoint. On simple math he sketches a $600 potential stock price (30x on $30 CY2030 EPS), stressing it is 4-5 years out and that he would not claim it as a base case. He treats the day as bullish confirmation for his 'ETF approach' trio of Marvell, Credo Technology (dip into the $150s-$160s was a buy, he says; up ~4%) and Astera Labs (up ~8%), and reads Broadcom as the bigger beneficiary given it leads the semi-custom market Marvell is chasing. Su's Taiwan remarks on expanding CPU/GPU production and wafer capacity are framed as another 'brick' in his bullish thesis house, with server CPU revenue guided up over 70% in 2027 and data-center revenue expected to more than double; he notes the server CPU market estimate grew from $60 billion (Nov 2025) to $220 billion. Calls: MRVL BUY (~$600 potential CY2030 model), AMD BUY, AVGO BUY (read-through), CRDO BUY ($150s-$160s dip zone), ALAB BUY. NVDA and MU mentioned only in passing. Caption notes: auto-captions garble Marvell as 'Marll'/'Marvel', Broadcom as 'Broncom', Credo as 'Credto', and Lisa Su as 'Lisa Sue'.

calls.thesis: Marvell investor day: FY2028 revenue outlook raised to ~$20B, $30 EPS guided for CY2030; at a 30x PE that implies a potential ~$600 stock price.
calls.base: FY2028 guide raised $18B->$20B (from $16.5B two quarters prior), driven by networking/scale-up-scale-out; custom silicon FY2029 target >$12B vs $10B+; data-center revenue $18B FY2028, target pulled a year early.
calls.bull: FY2031 model $70-90B revenue implying >$30 non-GAAP EPS at midpoint; he argues management is conservative and real numbers could be much higher.
calls.bear: Numbers are 4-5 years out ('blurriness'); new technologies/networking solutions could end the thesis; no sure thing in this space.
